name: Velocity Internet
summary: Canberra ISP (est. Aug 2003); acquired Goldweb Internet 2006, merged into NetSpeed group Nov 2010 (VELOCITY INTERNET PTY LIMITED (LATER WASVI PTY LIMITED), ACN 090 776 579); retail brand continues operating in Canberra as of Sep 2026 (ByteCard Pty Ltd t/a Velocity Internet, Mawson ACT).

events.details: Verified still operating as an ISP in Sep 2026 (current site retailing internet services; earlier death record removed).
